data.written: 2026-10-14, pin 6 head v2 (FAILURE_LOG F48). pin6head_send@v1 (the head redrawn over its own pixels, the pencil kept by a zero-weight band) came back re-posed: the pasted v2_0r failed the whole-picture pose gate (head position 0.048, bow +0.76 against +0.61, size x1.10, neck direction 22 degrees off, roll 50.5 against the pin's 38.8), carried two pencils (the pin's kept one and one drawn in the mouth), a pale wall patch and a seam on the shoulder at the crop edge. Gemini keeps what is drawn (F33, F37, F39, F44) and normalises a steeply bowed, rolled head when it redraws it, so v2 takes away every line it could follow, as the grey-out of pin 14's janeu3 did: in the crop (box 240-800 x 0-500 of the stage 1 v1_0r, run 20261013_193206, 922x1152; sent at 2x, 1120x1000) the whole head is flat grey 128 (hair, forehead, closed eye, nose, cheek, mouth, beard, throat, the side of the neck) and so is the pin's paintbrush, from the cheek to its far end over the wall (a 14 px band along its traced path), so that ONE paintbrush is drawn and the paste carries it. The pin's ear (traced at 7x, plus 5 px around it) is NOT grey: it stays real pixels, is not pasted, and pins the skull's place and roll. The grey shape's outline against the wall is the pin's silhouette (the person mask grown 2 px, with dark curls within 14 px of it on the right), so his hair, nose and chin end where the pin's do (size, bow and turn). Paste weights (tools/region_edit.py, soft mask): a 5 px ramp at the outline and at the ear, a 24 px ramp where the shape's edge lies on skin (the neck's left edge at x 262-296, the throat's lower edge at y 418), nothing grown into the wall (v1's pale wall patch), no cut through the shoulder (v1's seam at x 290: the left edge is now in the skin behind the neck, faded over 24 px, and above the ear it follows the hair). His references are the same two black-and-white photos as v1 (IMG_6858 front, IMG_6861 three-quarter right: the pin's head is turned toward picture-right) and a 4x crop of the pin's own paintbrush below the chin (over the wall: no face in it) for its look. The 10-01 v1 head is still not a reference (approval withdrawn). Feature positions as fractions of the 560x500 crop: closed eye 62 / 47, nose tip 45 / 74, the paintbrush from its upper end on the cheek at 18 / 60 across the lips at 36 / 80 to its far end at 47.5 / 92, ear 16-29 / 16-37. Pose measured on the pin (headpose.py, SCRFD): yaw -18.9, pitch -37.1, roll 38.8, face box 310 x 283 px in the 922x1152 frame; stage 1 -20.6 / -36.2 / 42.4.
